summary: Master the art of Training Needs Analysis and Program Design. Join this course to develop tailored training programs that drive performance and growth.
lede: Workforce capability gaps can be diagnosed through training needs analysis and used to shape targeted learning programs. For professionals who plan, deliver, or evaluate training, the course covers evidence collection, competency mapping, gap prioritization, measurable objectives, delivery design, and evaluation planning, including LMS workflows and Kirkpatrick’s Four Levels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, fund, deliver, or evaluate training programs and need stronger evidence for learning decisions.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with workplace training, HR, learning and development, or performance improvement processes. Prior experience with survey data, competency profiles, or training evaluation is helpful but not required. No coding or programming is required. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, with hands-on work using templates, matrices, and reporting tools rather than technical engineering.
